args.command:
cat > check.py << 'EOF'
import sys, numpy as np
f=sys.argv[1]
L=open(f).read().strip().split("\n"); n=int(L[0]); L=L[2:2+n]
S=[l.split()[0] for l in L]; X=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:4]] for l in L])
d=np.linalg.norm(X-X[38],axis=1)
print("Sb-donor:", {i:round(d[i],2) for i in (12,15,22,37,39,45,51)})
# connectivity check vs RDKit graph
from rdkit import Chem
smi = "CC(C)(C)c1cc(C(C)(C)C)c(O2)c(c1)[N+]3=C4C=CC=CC4=[N+]5c6cc(C(C)(C)C)cc(C(C)(C)C)c6O7.[W-2]2357(c8ccccc8)(c8ccccc8)(c8ccccc8)"
mh=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
bad=[]
for b in mh.GetBonds():
    i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx(); r=np.linalg.norm(X[i]-X[j])
    lim=2.6 if 38 in (i,j) else 1.65
    if r>lim: bad.append((i,j,S[i],S[j],round(r,2)))
print("broken bonds:",bad)
D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None],axis=2); np.fill_diagonal(D,9)
bs=set((b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()) for b in mh.GetBonds())
close=[(i,j,S[i],S[j],round(D[i,j],2)) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n) if D[i,j]<1.35 and (i,j) not in bs and (j,i) not in bs]
print("nonbonded close contacts:",close)
EOF
